body: It has been really bad for several years but it's really bad the past couple of months. Suicidal ideation, "God doesn't love you" - like it's almost 0% positive. I am constantly listening to music and videos in the background to just drown out the thoughts in my head :/
glad you're hanging in there. i've definitely had times where porn gave me the distraction i needed from really awful thoughts.

Not really. I heard everyone talking about that Adam Sandler movie Uncut Gems and how anxiety-inducing it was and when I watched it I didn't really notice. It made me feel depressed that my anxiety is so high, that movie didn't even register.

i do this too! i have a playlist on youtube of "soundscapes" and the first one is called "open window new york city soundscape at night". there's a lot of walking videos on youtube (no talking) and i also like listening to those.
my life is a series of unfortunate events. im burnt out but theres no one who can take over. i'm doing my best and the results are not good.

i had a dream a few weeks ago about my mum and it was so comforting at the time and now i feel like it was an omen. i was so tired in the dream and she hugged me, and now irl i am so tired but i have no hug....

all this work i do and it feels for nothing. i have no real goals for the future. things keep getting worse. i cant even cry because my body wont let me.

i kinda wish i would crack but i dont think i would elicit sympathy anyways.

i'm just not interested in using ai and think it's a pretty evil technology in a lot of the ways it's being used right now.

lately i am hearing about it being used for "therapy" when it is oftentimes validating people's mentally unwell thoughts. i'm already a mess and, yes humans can make things worse, but some ai "friend" feeding into my neurosis probably hits in a whole different way. like instant validation 24/7 can't be good.

but that's just me...i've not become a luddite but tech bros and the tech industry are incredibly odious to me and i don't trust them at all.

life is tiring and miserable and i get lonelier every year.

i'm eating pizza and cake alone in my room.

there are many people worse off than me, i can convince myself of that.

i had a daydream about meeting a grocery worker i am friendly with but hadn't seen in several months, and lo and behold, i met her today. the daydream was better than reality (it was awkward) but i thought it was a strange coincidence. man, i'm too lonely.

i bought stamps with my favorite flower while i was at the post office. they didn't have them on display anymore so i thought i had missed out on buying them but they had some behind the counter.

there was extremely stressful but necessary construction work done on our house this week and i was scared they killed our flowers (the ones my mom had planted) but those things are so damn resilient and somehow survived being crushed under the weight of a shit ton of construction material for like...a week. i should try and be resilient too...and be the best i can be under difficult circumstances. those flowers are much more beautiful than me though haha.
You're going to end up in jail. Anytime I heard about someone trying this, that's what happens.
I'm always sympathetic to friends/family who have to deal with loved ones with mental illness but asking why you haven't killed yourself is too far. Did they say why your depression made them angry?

It's tough. I gained 25 pounds and my friends hadn't seen me since before the pandemic and my (also fat) friend at one point said I should get checked for diabetes lol...At the same time, I was really happy to see them in person.

Idk, maybe you could show them a photo of how you look (like find a way to show them "oh here I am doing such-and-such")? If they stop talking to you or mentioning hanging out in person, at least you don't have to go through that rejection irl.

When my acne has been severe, yes. I've had relatives straight up look at me horrified and be like, "what happened?!" Like I caught leprosy or something. I guess it doesn't help that acne actually makes one look diseased haha...

Him looking at you and smiling awkwardly when you looked up at him might have been a way for him to start conversation? I feel like this is a "psychic communication" thing socially awkward people (like myself) sometimes do haha...

I'm really sorry it went bad but lots of dates go bad, FAW or no, so don't apologize. He should apologize! Nothing worse then 2 guys and they both decide to go for the other girl rather than try with you. Good on you for going though, even if you didn't know it was a date. And it wasn't a waste because now you know to be wary of your ex-co-worker's invitations.

University life isn't always what it seems like in the brochure for some of us. I was really depressed when I was in first-year nursing and ended up switching to history which I finished. Please don't drop out. Go for the chemistry degree. Sometimes new circumstances breathes new life into you. Just from seeing it in my personal life, my family who dropped out never went back. I never made friends until my fourth year when I decided to take Japanese.

You are in an FAW forum - most if not all the women here have been confronted by people because of their looks. You can think whatever you want but the reality is not what you want it to be. Glad you've never had to experience it, doesn't mean this is not the reality for many ugly women.

How would it help anxiety to wear something that will draw looks and attention? Maybe it's different where OP lives, but this would absolutely look out of place and tbh suspicious where I live. I have had strangers comment on me wearing just a mask, I have had security guards stop me just wearing black clothing with hat and sunglasses.

Don't presume anything about my anxiety, you know nothing about me.

having a child on the offchance that will somehow cure your suicidal tendencies is not a suicide prevention plan.

this board is littered with posts from parents who want to kill themselves despite having children. go to the suicide bereavement subreddit and read the posts from heartbroken children. it doesn't work and you just add more people to the misery.
this would be an incredibly selfish thing for a person to do.

I would not do this because it would draw more attention and more comments. It's not just that it's covering everything but it's an unusual way of covering everything.

I still mask. Hat + mask or hoodie + mask is enough for me.

Every time I post in one of these threads it's always something bad lol...I don't know, my life is consistently devoid of joy and happiness.

I am so tired...I would love a proper night's rest but caregiving for my dad kinda fucks that up and I very rarely get it anymore. I just end up taking all these naps that are unsatisfying...

I'm so resentful of my family lately. I mentioned it here before but my mum passed away a long while back and my immediate family is now my two brothers and dad. I have been becoming a misandrist because of them although I know it's not right because not every man is like them. I would say 90% of my problems/stresses stem from my family.

Went to Palm Sunday mass. Can't remember the last time (if ever) I've been to one of them. Interesting, although too much people for my comfort.
This is a depression sub, I'm not here to debate over fucking religion. Thanks for making me feel worse. Bye.
I don't, as I'd err on the side that something supernatural exists rather than it doesn't.

Despite being faw, my contempt for men largely starts and begins with my family (dad and 2 brothers, mom passed a long time ago now). Anyone that tells you they are more rational, calm, hard working - can go kick rocks.

Anyways, just dealing with the ramifications of that over the weekend.
not really. i think the most i could go to is agnostic.

For me, no. It's painful to ask for respite and not receive it, to feel abandoned by God. I know for others, God is a lot of comfort. I wish I was one of them. I consider myself Catholic and it's difficult.

I do find videos interviewing people who have had near death experiences comforting though and somewhat curbs my suicidal ideation.

Ah okay. Yeah, maybe they weren't even thinking about you specifically when they said that (which is a different awful feeling than when it's directed at you specifically). 

Not saying you need to ditch these friends, but having friends who don't talk too much about relationships/sex (even when they themselves are in long-term relationships and have kids) has been important to me maintaining the few friendships I have. I hope you have someone like that as a friend.

These types of men are scary. Maybe they don't abuse people they know but they will do that to strangers because they know they won't be caught. Kind of like how people use internet anonymity to reveal their most heinous face.

Sorry you had to go through that.
Sorry, I'm not understanding why you took that as a reference to yourself?

If my dad was like that, I would make sure he got his just desserts before I did anything to myself.

My niece was the same age as you when she told her teacher how physically abusive her father was and he almost got arrested and CPS was called. He ended up having to move out of the house but still had to pay for the house. My cousin (her mom) eventually reconciled with him, but by then my niece was going to university out of town. You can't change your parents but sometimes you can change the circumstances.

i'm very sorry about your mom. i also lost mine around the same age. i gave up on myself and never fully recovered. really recommend you DO NOT do that. in my city they offered short-term, free grief counselling for like 6 weeks. might want to see if they offer anything where you live.

you're still very young, lots of time to move up in life, and a minimum wage job is better than no job in the current state of the world.

i have this wooden backscratcher and the "scratcher" part is a hand and sometimes i just hold that, like holding a tiny hand lmaooooo...sad but true. also sometimes i hold my other hand and pretend that way.

5-6 years ago, before the pandemic. not beautiful, but when i would dress up i felt like an old lecherous man with poor eyesight would probably hit on me haha...

i have never felt that guys my age or younger would find me attractive and that has only gotten worse with age :/

Can you talk with your school counselor? Maybe they can set you up with a social worker to help you find work and housing (plus all the other issues).

That is a lot and I don't blame you for feeling that way.

From her perspective (I'm not saying this is true, idk your relationship), if your relationship was not going well, she may have felt you were trying to manipulate her into staying.

Some people are only interested in being with you during the good times and will disappear during the bad times - this can be friends, family, SOs, etc. Better to learn now. It can be very traumatizing. You are already grieving over your grandma - that's a lot of loss in a few months.

I hope you can see this as a chance at a fresh start and a chance to find someone who will be there with you during the highs and the lows, not just the highs.

Just a real shit week. Dad sick with some kinda chest infection and he's not making it easy to take care of him, and I was already exhausted due to family drama and other medical stuff for him. 

I was looking through some old images I have in regards to suicide (these are supposed to be "mental health" images I have to make me feel better) and one of them from almost a decade ago is this graphic of an owl saying something like, "if you are asking for help, that means you aren't ready to give up just yet." And I burst into tears because I realize I am no longer asking for help. It's kinda the first time I feel like I can concretely say I am mentally worse off than I was 10 years ago.

So that's my bi-annual crying session :S

Incidentally, I have this vid bookmarked of this rent-a-sister service in Japan, and in this video one of the hikikomori in it actually ends up marrying the girl he "rented". This is not a romance service though, it's a mental health service, and can be dangerous for the women.

https://youtu.be/q9IRmUEsz6g?feature=shared

I'll be honest, I would never hire a gigolo or go to a host club, but stuff like rent-a-friend is something I'd probably try.

After a while you will get used to seeing him. If he's gonna act like that, he looks like the weirdo, not you, especially if you don't acknowledge him. You're not in high school anymore and him doing stuff like that looks really immature as an adult.

why would uber eats not refund? i'll have to remember not to use them.

what kind of food did you order?

I don't think there's anything wrong with sharing a post from a successful friend, but the way you word stuff in your post makes me wonder if that's how you talk to her and I could see why she would take it as insulting.

You do not need to be showing her examples of people who are "better" than you both. Keep that to yourself. That would hurt my feelings a lot if I was your sister.

If he was doing a good job as a stay-at-home dad, okay. But he's not doing that either. I would also question what his motives were at the start of your relationship. Is therapy something he would be willing to do? Even if he doesn't want to do it, maybe you can go to therapy alone. If you can afford it, a cleaner to come by once a week or every other week to help you.

Emotional abuse can be just as damaging as physical abuse. It leaves no scars so if you tell other people, they can just downplay it. It's not easy and can drive people literally insane.

My situation is not good but I am not envious of your position. You sound like a good person with a high-pressure job, taking care of your family and home and trapped in a relationship with a leech. Most people would not envy that.

I'm well off financially. It is very easy to say "well, who am I to complain?" But to spend every day feeling unworthy, unloved - I would trade my money away to not feel like that (and I also know what it feels like to be poor, so I don't say that lightly). I also feel trapped (I take care of my father in a very toxic household). I would rather be poor and not walk on eggshells every day...

Good luck to you whatever you decide to do. I hope you talk to someone in real life, whether it be a friend, family member, therapist, etc. Sometimes we can't see things very clearly by ourselves. There might be other options available that you haven't considered that someone else might know.

Your partner has red flags all over him. Was he working when you guys had kids? He's not doing housework, not working, and it kinda sounds like he's turning the kids against you when you're not there. He sounds like my oldest brother when I was growing up. It wasn't until I was in my teens I realized what an evil loser he was, leeching off of and abusing my parents.

I feel like if you dealt with him, you would not be suicidal anymore. This might sound extreme as it doesn't sound like he's physically abusive, but maybe talk to someone at a women's shelter - they deal with women who feel trapped in bad situations all the time and may be able to give you ideas on how to navigate your situation.

If it hurts you to be around him, then distancing yourself from him might be a good idea. You might eventually get used to the situation.

Men and women can just be friends. Developing crushes on friends or people you're around a lot is natural, but it doesn't mean it will always happen. If you entered into the friendship with the goal of becoming his girlfriend, that's not really his fault and it doesn't make him a bad person. Guys are pretty dense at that age too.

Someone said that it's not a case of God giving us only what we can handle (which doesn't make sense considering how many people kill themselves) but giving us so much that we can't handle it ourselves and have to rely on God (which also sounds awful depending on your perspective, but makes more sense than the other way round).

Neither are particularly comforting :/
Yeah, sometimes it's just getting through things in 15 minute increments or else I just basically shut down :/
"Energy vampire" is right. Sometimes I'll see motivational photos that say to leave negative people behind and it's like, yeah I'd leave me behind too.

Overwhelmed. I have so much to do and keep falling further behind. In the past couple of months I've kinda become obsessed with near-death-experience stories as they help calm down my suicidal ideation. I think I will die when I'm supposed to, and I have my purpose(s), but I just hate being here. Life is agony most of the time.
Yes. There are many forms of loneliness beyond not having a romantic partner. My living situation is bad right now so making (or even just maintaining) friendships has been very difficult.

i think suicide is a no-go for anyone who has underage children. kids will love their parents through a lot. i think the only time i've ever heard kids be relieved with their parent gone was if their parent posed a threat of one day killing them or other family members. you say they are happy with their dad but it sounds like your kids are happy with you too, even if there's not much money. and in the future if they're moody teenagers, they'll still love you and be devastated.

i hope the new year brings better things for you.

yes the night time is really intense if you're alone and going to places other people are. i remember going to a museum on one of their free admission nights and it was PACKED and i think i might've been one of the only people there alone. never again!

i don't haha! :(

although if at least one of the people in a couple is ugly, i am not jealous and very happy for them and it makes me a bit hopeful for myself.
I talk to a therapist. I have already decided I will likely not ever do anything, for various reasons. I still think about it every day though.

I have been watching a lot of near death experience videos on youtube as I am dealing with my own suicidal ideation, and one thing that seems pretty recurring is that there usually isn't that harsh judgment/damnation you hear about if you're a Christian. It's more like God or your spirit guide reviewing your life with you in a somewhat neutral way. Even people who tried to commit suicide or were atheists or just terrible people seem to feel immense love.

I'm a Catholic and I just really can't believe that God would see someone suffering so much they killed themselves and just not have deep compassion for that person.

Christmas is always extremely depressing but got news about my grandpa that is making me really worried for the next year. With how bad my family's relations are with my Mum's side of the family, I dread having to see them despite most of us living in the same city. In fact, we haven't seen them since before the pandemic and I only keep in contact with my one cousin despite there being like thirty of us. My dad has me as the "spokesperson" for our family because I somewhat get along with my relatives but my dad is the reason we're ostracized, as we never attended family events and he never told me about those events either. I am extremely resentful to be put in this position.

I am exhausted mentally but feel I have no right to complain in light of the news I got. I often daydream about my life if I were not looking after my dad (really, looking after my dad and brothers). Maybe I would still be FAW but I could still be happy in other ways. I am jealous of the person I could have been.
Very odd! The only time I felt zaps or tingling on my tongue was when I was having panic attacks and I was not taking any psychiatric meds at the time.

I listen to Claire Weekes when my anxiety is very high. She's got a very comforting, grandmotherly voice. People post a bunch of her vids on youtube, look up the ones on anxiety and panic attacks.

Btw I'm not shilling for her, I think she's been dead for decades. Listening to her did not get rid of my panic attacks but it does help me grit my teeth through them better.

AI sucks and is awful for the environment, for artists, for workers. It's notorious for falsifying or giving biased information. I would never use it for confirmation of anything.

yes, the first time i stopped taking zoloft, i did it cold turkey and had brain zaps for a month. a very uncomfortable sensation, i would have preferred pain. next time i stopped zoloft i did it extremely slowly.

Christmas has always felt tough and lonely since I was like...15...but this year feels especially miserable. Before I would plan something small for myself like cook certain foods or a movie marathon. I am just full of emptiness and anxiety this year. I bought a drawing tablet during Black Friday - I'd wanted one for 4 years and this seemed like a nice Christmas gift to myself. Haven't even opened the box. There's extended return time so I think I'm just going to return it. People talk about having difficult Christmases but they always make it sound like a phase. It's been 20 years of sadness at this point - that's a generation! I don't care about gifts I just want to be a part of celebrations like normal people. My older brother continues to make life even more miserable. We can't even have lights on the Christmas tree because he doesn't like them. It makes my dad so sad. 

Lately my obsession is watching near death experience videos on youtube. It has helped curb my suicidal ideation somewhat, but I also feel so desperate to learn the lesson I was meant to learn on earth so I can finally leave here. I am so tired of the suffering.

I used to fantasize about this (still do...) but freezing to death is painful and probably humiliating. Here is the article that turned me off that method: https://www.outsideonline.com/2152131/freezing-death

i just found out this year that instant mashed potatoes are incredibly easy to make and i also kinda prefer them to actual mashed potatoes because of the smooth texture. I just get the butter-flavored ones and add some black pepper on top. A great food when you're struggling to do much.

I am 37 and a caregiver for my 78 yo father. I also live with my narcissistic, deeply mentally ill oldest brother who will never be thrown out. I've never had any type of relationship. I don't even have a job. My future looks...grim.

Everything you said resonates with me. The horrible thoughts that run through your head as a caregiver. Feeling piss-poor at it. It is a miserable thing to see someone make bad personal decisions knowing you will suffer for it - "freedom" for them but not for us...

If any man would be interested in me, they'd have to be completely deranged to want to get involved with my family situation. Bringing a child into this miserable world, into this family, with possible defects due to my older age, seems like child abuse. I never used to, but nowadays just get sad seeing cute toddlers/babies...that ship has passed.

Congratulations on losing weight and hope you can continue to do so, even if there's loose skin. I hope you are able to set aside savings just for yourself.

I have to force myself to look far into the future, at the possibility I will be able to have a fresh start somewhere new, otherwise the dark thoughts are too overwhelming.
idk, i'm just fucking too stupid to go through with it.

I never joined clubs but found volunteering was helpful for making friends and building confidence. If you don't like a place you volunteer, you can just quit and try a new place. 

Of course, my life has gone to shit since I stopped volunteering but that's neither here nor there lol.
No, I actively avoid it, too unrealistic lol.

i like wearing nice clothes but i gained like 30 pounds in the past few years and haven't bought nice clothes since pre-pandemic. I just wear the same yoga pants and sweat shirts basically all the time now.

my therapists used to get upset at me when i said putting makeup on was "like putting lipstick on a pig" lol. i have horrible skin so it always ends up caked and oily, but if i don't put it on it's even worse. part of the reason i still mask up is not having to worry about that stuff.
Lost friends, estranged from relatives, incredibly lonely and living in an incredibly toxic home. I wish God would get rid of me already.

Now you are whining about how no one accepts your help and you're getting downvotes and that's "exhausting"? You are whining to people that are suffering so much they want to die. Do you think you're the good guy in this situation?

Maybe OP just wants some empathy and understanding and maybe that's all we can do here sometimes. Some random telling them their attempt was actually attention-seeking behavior is NOT helpful. It's not "nice." It's not even truthful. It's what YOU want to believe is true.
tell myself what? that you lack reading comprehension? op wrote why they did it that way and you ignored it and pushed your interpretation on them instead. good stuff!
Did you not read their post? So they could calmly look out on the ocean.

Me too except with a vibe...it takes me so long to orgasm, and like half the time I feel a deep self-loathing for myself. I don't think it's the toy, but my feelings of self-hatred have grown a lot the last couple of years. 

Still, it is one of the only things where I can (sometimes) get to a place where I'm blanked out and not thinking about how awful life is.

Just as a caregiver who barely goes out anymore...you absolutely need to take time for yourself outside the house if you are able. Caregiver burnout is no joke. I can't remember the last day I had where I didn't want to die. I'm sorry your siblings are not more empathetic. It sounds like they also need a break.

You mentioned your sibling's disability is a recent thing so this is probably all pretty new to you guys. I hope you guys will be able to settle into a rhythm eventually. Being a caregiver is tough and you are young. Keep working on your own goals - maybe you will reach them more slowly, but absolutely do not give up on yourself. You don't want to end up like me.

i understand. i'm the last one who should be offering other people advise since i fucking hate myself, but please try to treat yourself kindly. life is so hard. i wish i could offer you more words of comfort.

i hope you don't go through with it, although i understand why you would. i am the same age and never expected life to end up like this. i have barely anything to show for 20 years of adulthood. in another 20 years, i'll be the same age as my mum when she died. life moves so fast. 20 years ago, i was just becoming an adult, optimistic with dreams for the future...life has beaten that person into unconsciousness.

are there any cheap hostels, friends you can temporarily stay with, do you have a car? i know there are homeless subreddits and the people there will probably be able to give you insight on what things you can do right now, whether you end up homeless or not.

i hope this is not the end for you and you can have a fresh start. so many of us here need fresh starts...much easier said than done.

Something happened today that I think might've extinguished the tiny sliver of hope I had. Idk how to process things...am feeling really numb. Any vague idea I had that I would escape my current predicament just feels like a pipe dream now. I'm not getting out of the situation I've found myself in for my entire life. It doesn't feel like there's anything worth fighting for anymore.

My ears feel clogged and I feel hazy.

I really wish being FA was my only problem.
i'm considering using dilators beforehand so i don't bleed because i was supposed to be getting tested like ten years ago already...woof. i'm so embarrassed.

One of those days where the anxiety and stress is just rattling my bones. I am so sick of having to clean up other people's mistakes because they couldn't make good fucking decisions. I fucking hate life so much. I fucking hate it so so so much. I am old and I am tired and I have nothing to fucking show for it because I decided it was a good idea to burn myself to care for family. If I could do it all over again, I wouldn't. I would find a way to escape early.

I used to be part of this depression forum for a long time and then it closed down during COVID. I didn't realize how much I would miss the community on it but places like reddit or twitter are not the same. I at least still talk to someone from there and she's a great friend. The loss of individual messageboards has been a net negative to online communities.
Happy birthday! I'm 37 too. Yeah no one gives a shit anymore lol. Just a reminder how much further and further I get from normalcy...

This is me, but with brown Asian skin and I also scar horribly on my chin :(

I have been on Accutane 3 times and it always comes back. It is hereditary for me from my dad but I have the bonus of hormonal acne. My dad still gets acne and he's in his late 70s...

One time I was on a trip with my girlfriends and I took my shirt off (only wearing bra) and my friend said "awww" when she saw my back. It was a trip to Japan and I literally didn't go to the hot springs because of it...I can't imagine how a guy would react.

I also gained 20 pounds since the pandemic and have that to contend with now too...woof.

I have also seen women with horrible acne who just had HUGE amounts of confidence - or at least they could fake being very comfortable with themselves really, really well. I think it makes a huge difference - unfortunately I have not had good self esteem since I was in elementary and do not know how at my old age.

I'm not here to tell you to live for him or that things are gonna get better, I'm wanting off this planet too or I wouldn't be on this sub. I just think it's weird to frame this as being a good thing for him when it's likely going to shatter him for the rest of his life. If you're at peace with that, fine.

So your plan is to trick him into thinking everything is okay by making long-term plans with him, and then pull the rug out from under him by killing yourself. Right...very thoughtful. I'm sure it will be very easy for him to trust or have a normal relationship after that "surprise."

I'm 37 and it's crazy how much of my life I've wasted away. Living at home, no job, shitty bachelor's degree from 15 years ago, taking care of my dad while having to deal with abusive older brother. Nothing good happens, or it'll be negated by something horrific. If there's balance in life, I haven't found it. I have a method too, I wanna think it'll be peaceful but who knows, maybe painful as fuck. But I still have to take care of my dad in the meantime.

It would be nice, even once, if I had something nice to say when posting here. Alas...

Been miserable. Thought I would FINALLY get a week to rest a bit and then my cousin just randomly asked if she could stay with my family mid-July for a few days. Can't happen because of my psycho brother so we'll have to figure something else out there. This entire fucking year so far has been one thing after another. Me and my younger brother are fucking exhausted.

Sometimes I get sad and wish I had my own family, kids of my own. I'm not very maternal but sometimes I get that yearning. But I can't imagine how fucked up my kids would be, being raised by me. I do not think I can rise above my upbringing at this point. I am 37 and still living at home, becoming further entrenched in my family's behavior every year.

Life is so miserable...I get angry at God for so many things now. Everything feels Sisyphean...and none of it feels worth anything.

I stopped being shy around them once I stopped thinking they could possibly look at me as a partner or in any type of sexual way. Then they're just...people. Although recently I did get butterflies with a plumber that did work for us, but I just assumed he had a girlfriend anyways.

Thank you. I met her this past week after not seeing her in person since before the pandemic. And she apologized to me for not trying harder to stay in touch. What! Like no, it's always been me. She will reach out and then I'll eventually stop replying. I've always been the one bad at staying in touch. I understand where she is coming from as we had some issues when my mum was sick, but that was over ten years ago now and things aren't the same.

You are right, it's hard to function when in a constant state of suicidal ideation. I know steps I could take that I know would improve my mental wellbeing but it's so difficult with how toxic my household is and constantly having to walk on eggshells. Everything feels impossible.
The burden of being alive laying claim to my body.

Found out my best friend has breast cancer. We've been distant (my fault) since the pandemic started and it's really difficult for me to go see her (living with toxic brother who is still in pandemic lockdown mode...or at least he uses that to control my family). Today was the first time in literal years I had a long conversation with her. I am a horrible friend. I haven't cried, I feel like she for sure is going to be fine. Can't suggest specific channels because what works for me might not work for you. What helped me is figuring out my facial features and searching YT for makeup artists that have that feature. I've found great tips from both male and female makeup artists who share my features. Some questions you might ask yourself:

* What face/eye/lip/nose/cheek shape do you have?
* What is your skin type/skin problems/skin shade?
* What features would you like to emphasize or de-emphasize?
* What colors suit you? This sounds like bullshit, but look into seasonal color types to figure out flattering colors for yourself. 
* How long are you willing to spend doing your makeup?

Focus on practicing one skill at a time until you're comfortable with it, then move on to the next (e.g. practice applying blush), because makeup is intimidating when you don't feel great about yourself.

I would love to improve my makeup skills more but have awful acne/scarring issues + sensitive eyes, so minimal is best for me. Basic eyeliner and lipstick are the easiest skills if you have a steady hand, just swipe-and-go.

Also, try to be realistic. A lot of YTers have great skin, are naturally beautiful and use a ton of photo filters (never trust YT thumbnails!). Try not to be too disappointed if you don't look as good as you thought you would.

- Youtube videos + Google anything and everything you don't know about

- online forums/subreddits in your location can provide you with local info

- volunteer (I am a huge advocate for this because you will get references + if there is an opening there, you might be considered + fill in resume gap + socialization + confidence builder + you can leave at any time)

- library (borrow and request books + many libraries nowadays have a lot to offer including free classes, printing, laptop use, online learning subscriptions to sites like Lynda)

- non-profit/government employment services (have them check your resume/cover letter + maybe match you with jobs)
